demo.after_zh: 纠正后：上身微微前倾，把球压住再打。下一脚可以再录一段对比。
demo.after_en: After correction: a slight forward lean keeps the shot down. Record the next strike to compare.

triggered_rules.feedback_zh: 上身后仰过多，容易打飞；微微前倾压球。
triggered_rules.feedback_en: Too much back lean — slight forward lean helps keep the shot down.
